statements: src/config.mjs mixes reading lines and filling in variables. Move the reading into parseLines(text) in src/parse.mjs, which returns a list of { key, value, line }, and the filling in into interpolate(entries, env) in src/interpolate.mjs, which returns the finished object. parseConfig(text, env) stays in src/config.mjs and composes them.
Every answer and every error parseConfig gives today stays exactly the same. Other teams depend on it.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Split the config parser into a reading step and an interpolation step, as the numbered statements describe. Nothing about parseConfig may change. Follow the conventions already in the code.
